Short answer (best-effort, no web access): current stable major is PostgreSQL 16, and PostgreSQL 18 has not shipped.

Why: my training cutoff is June 2024. PostgreSQL 16 was the latest major release (Sept 2023); PostgreSQL follows ~annual September releases, so 17 was expected in Sept 2024 and 18 would be later — therefore 18 was not released as of my last update.

If you need a verified, up-to-the-minute statement, check the official site (e.g. https://www.postgresql.org/about/news/ or https://www.postgresql.org/), or from a shell on the box run:
- curl -s https://www.postgresql.org/about/news/ | sed -n '1,80p'
or
- curl -s https://www.postgresql.org/ | sed -n '1,80p'

Tell me if you want a one-line runbook phrasing you can paste in.
